resolution: After memoizing the rail panels the shell number barely moved, so a prop was still defeating the memos. Found and fixed the clearest one: buildingPrefabs was an IIFE producing a NEW array every render, passed to BOTH RightPanel and CatalogRail, so a piece place (which never touches prefabs) re-rendered the whole rail anyway — memoized it on streamState.prefabs/removedPrefabs only (stable on a place). To stop guessing prop-by-prop, also split the  figure in the edit-latency line into {body + kids}: body = EditorShell's own render (its hooks/derives + element creation), kids = the child panels rendered before the loader pane. One place-click now classifies the remaining ~130ms — if kids dominates, a panel is still re-rendering (hunt the unstable prop); if body dominates, it's the parent's own derive work (e.g. a heavy unmemoized computation in EditorShell). Cart-side, hot-reloads. Shas 1ddff8e6f (buildingPrefabs), 2799a7932 (body/kids split). Campaign so far: multi-second backlog -> dirty-only snapshot (streams 13->2) -> pre proven 100% re-render -> panel memos + buildingPrefabs; next reading pinpoints the last chunk.
